title: Actively maintained replication code and reproducibility report for Coppock and Kaur (2022)
description:
Actively maintained replication code and reproducibility report for Coppock and Kaur (2022).

The maintained version rewrites the cleaning and analysis code so that it runs on current R and current packages, operating directly on the data as originally deposited. The repository also holds the ground truth comparing every published claim against the archival and maintained code, and the itemized errata. This record's concept DOI always resolves to the latest version.
